reviews.author: Julie P.
reviews.text:
I use it often because it's near my office, but it's always crowded and busy.
However, there are a lot of mistakes in ordering and the drinks are not very tasty.
Unlike other stores, the vanilla latte is bland and doesn't taste like coffee at all;;;
Last time, I ordered a cold brew latte, but it just came out as cold brew... If the order doesn't go through properly according to the sticker on the outside, I can't help but be suspicious even if I pay extra and order decaf... haha.

reviews.author: YO LEE
reviews.text: It is a world-class coffee franchise located between Euljiro 3-ga Station and Yeongnak Correctional Center. In the past, it was an area with many printing shops, but recently, as many large buildings have been built, development is progressing naturally. Recently, many young people are gathering in the surrounding commercial district under the name Hipjiro. This store has a good location and is quite spacious, making it a convenient place to make an appointment. The drinks are not much different from other places, but I think they are relatively expensive.

reviews.author: lovely恩
reviews.text: It's a spacious store with a constant flow of people. I purchased Jeju tangerine limeade and a reusable bag. Although it was made of polyester, it was sturdy. I especially liked the color. I made a mistake in selecting the Jeju Green Tangerine Limeade cup, but they were very kind enough to cancel and reorder it. I was able to stay comfortably thanks to the friendly service.

The juices provided by grinding peach + plum, kiwi + banana, and grapefruit ade are really delicious.

reviews.author: It's so good
reviews.text:
I expected it in advance after reading reviews that the entrance would be difficult to find, so it was easier to find than I thought.

If you plan to visit, be sure to refer to the photo of the entrance!!!

I went on a weekday morning and there were no people and it was quiet.
They say there is a lot of waiting and a lot of people on weekends, but I couldn't help but give the atmosphere a higher score since there were hardly any people there.

The brunch I ate alone was clean and delicious.

The fluffy pancakes had a slight sweetness and a basic base that was very good!

I was also very satisfied with the carrot laffe. It can be salty when eaten alone, but it goes well with pancakes and arugula.

The overall harmony was very good, and I recommend trying the salt, pepper, and syrup first before adding them.

Personally, I didn’t like yogurt😢

reviews.author: HAN
reviews.text: Neither drinks nor food have any major strengths. The non-coffee drinks have almost no taste, and neither the plate nor the acidity are signature. Despite its popularity, the quality cannot match it. Even though prices have been rising recently, it is disappointing that the prices are too high. I've been there once and I recommend going just once.

reviews.author: Ga young Bae
reviews.text:
It's been a popular cafe in Euljiro for quite some time, but there are still quite a lot of people these days. I ordered an iced Americano and the signature dessert here, Fruit Sando.
Fruit Sando is a mini cake-like sandwich made with light whipped cream and fresh fruit on white bread. It has a pretty shape and the whipped cream is not greasy, so it goes well with coffee. Coffee has a heavy taste, so it goes well with desserts. I think it's a place worth visiting at least once. The interior doesn't feel clean or unique. City Pop comes out and goes well with the dessert you're after.

Dessert and coffee were delicious,
Perhaps because the space was small, the noise felt loud.
Weekend usage time is 2 hours.

I went to Bunkasha and the store was really hidden! The interior feels like a renovated clothing-making studio, so it’s very atmospheric! I went to eat some fruit and it was really refreshing and delicious!🥪🍓
The drinks came in small cups, but they were quite generous so I enjoyed them!
The atmosphere inside is really nice.
It's so moist that you can't even recognize the fruit acidity as an uncooked bread, and it goes well with the whipped cream, so it's really delicious!🤗

reviews.text: Euljiro emotional coffee house. I like the retro atmosphere. A place better at night than during the day. All the drinks are delicious, and the desserts are good too. reviews.author: Soojin Jeong
reviews.text:
This is a retro-style cafe in Euljiro.
The atmosphere and decorations are cute and pretty.
Coffee beans have two flavors: sour and savory, and both are delicious.
I like vanilla latte, so I had it with ice. I don't know if it's because there is no separate ice glass or if it's a unique feature of this restaurant, but it felt like a regular water glass without depth.
As a result, there is not a lot of ice in it, and since there is not much ice, it melts quickly and becomes sour.
If you find it disappointing that at regular cafes, if you take a few sips through a straw, only ice remains, this is the opposite case.....
As for the cake, the Earl Gray pound cake is okay, but the cheesecake is very sweet.
It was a very pretty looking cake, but the taste couldn't match its appearance. It's a shame......

reviews.author: Sunny
reviews.text:
It's near my office, so it's my favorite cafe that I often go to!
The desserts are made in-house, and it feels like each and every ingredient was put with great care, so I try a new drink every time I go.
Among them, my favorite is the Almond Cream Latte!!!!
The Basque cheesecake goes really well together!!!
It's been quite a while since Euljibin opened, but it seems like there are more and more people, which is nice, but it's also sad that a place that only I want to know about is becoming known, and the staff are so friendly, so it's a place I go to when I'm feeling down or just want to blank out.

The space is quite spacious.

It's in a place like this...? It's located where you want to be. As I climb the stairs, I keep asking myself...
First of all, I may have felt that way because I didn't really like the retro, Euljiro sensibility.
It seems too backworld...I think the industrial interior is basic, but it was just accented with a vinyl tent, and it had an atmosphere that was described as old rather than retro.
Since the space was not large, it felt a bit cluttered rather than hip.
If you like this kind of atmosphere, I think you will be satisfied.

What I was a little disappointed with was the drink. The jelly on top looked like it was made by hand.
The drink itself is small in volume, but it feels like it's just carbonated and very sweet syrup added. But it was 8,500 won.
I ordered it because it seemed like a signature dish, but I just ordered coffee.
It wasn't good value for money.. I usually go to cafes.
There are many places that are very satisfactory in everything, including the atmosphere, location, taste of drinks, etc.
What..? I felt a lot like this

reviews.text: It's hard to find the cafe. I went there in the evening, but the building itself was quiet and dark, so I thought it was a ruined place with only the location still registered... haha ​​If you go up the stairs to the 3rd floor of the building, open the iron door inside and George will come out! There are six tables and there is also seating for three at the bar at the order counter. Maybe because I went in the evening, the inside of the cafe was so dark that I couldn't read the menu very well, so I looked at it with a flashlight and ordered it. The food I received was so pretty that when I took a picture, it had a really dark vintage style, so I took this photo with a flashlight as well... The cake and drinks tasted good, but the price wasn't right for the size of the cake and the amount in the drink.. If you order a drink, you'll see the huge size and amount of ice ^^ The temple smokes on the counter. I also lit incense, but it made me dizzy so I was able to leave the cafe quickly. It's hard to gamble with hips.. haha

It's not something you have to look for and visit, but the location is good so it's a good place to take a break while passing by.

reviews.author: BONG
reviews.text:
It's a place I visit often because it's cheaper than other nearby cafes and the coffee is pretty high quality and delicious.

The amount of coffee on the regular menu is a bit small, but there is a separate large menu and the kiosk is well-equipped, so even people who have difficulty speaking through sign language or writing can order without much trouble.

The bakery menu is also quite delicious and reasonably priced.
The staff is friendly and it is a great cafe to enjoy coffee in peace.

reviews.author: Seongryeol Lee
reviews.text:
Yesterday, I visited Baeknyeongwan around 3:43 for a meeting with a friend at a savings bank. I saw that the lights were off and asked the female employee inside if they were closed. She said yes. When I went to order, a tall man came out and started yelling and glaring at me. I was dumbfounded when I saw him yelling in words I couldn't understand and clenching his fist as if he was going to hit someone.
I tried to call the Euljiro District Police once, but I held back.
No, then you said you wouldn't do business from the beginning?
Behind the scenes, the female employee again said she wouldn't do it this time and asked what to do, telling that tall male employee to get proper training. Are you going to beat him?
And while I was in the middle of a meeting, I saw someone yelling "Happy Birthday?" as if they were leaving the building and telling me to leave work quickly. It was very unpleasant.
Provide proper employee training
Oh, and I don't know if there are any employees who smoke there.
When I went to a meeting last week, I ordered coffee and it smelled like cigarette smoke.
I can't say anything about it because it's a favorite food, but did you at least wash your hands before ordering it?

Next time something like this happens, I will file a complaint with the bank.

reviews.author: Seunghee Han
reviews.text:
I recently stopped by Baeknyeon Viewpoint for some business.
That afternoon, while I was talking with an employee, my voice wasn't loud and we were just talking about work.
A female employee wearing white clothes and fat glasses!
Just smile and make an impression and drink as if telling you to leave quickly.
Put it down and the service is amazing!
I don't know if you didn't like the sound of your voice or if you were in a bad mood that day, but where do you give such crappy service?
I didn't ask them to do it themselves.
I didn't want to offend anyone, so I just left, but please make sure your employees get proper training!
P.s If you delete it, I will upload it again.

reviews.author: Shin Dong-won (Shiny Shadow)
reviews.text:
A cozy, hidden wine bar
The wine you recommended was also sweet and refreshing, so I really liked it.
I highly recommend the snacks as they are more than basic and reasonably priced.
However, there may be some likes and dislikes about oyster pasta. (Due to the nature of the food, it may taste salty and fishy as it cools.)
Just order the rest of the snacks, they're delicious.

reviews.author: SOYEON CHO
reviews.text:
Last order in the kitchen is 10 o'clock, but it's open until 12 o'clock, and it's the best place to drink wine late at night, open all year round.
I ordered tomato basil pasta, oil shrimp pasta, and kimchi fried rice. The kimchi fried rice was just my style. It was moist and flavorful, perfect as a side dish!!
Tomato pasta is so delicious that you can't help but think about it.
Additional sauces are provided upon request.
all self
If you purchase a white wine bottle, it will be immediately replaced with the wine in the refrigerator, so there is no need to worry about chilling.
The space is spacious, but there is a waiting issue.

reviews.author: Na Young Park
reviews.text:
The wine price is very good. The snacks are delicious and it's great to drink comfortably in a casual atmosphere.
It may be a bit inconvenient because you have to go back and forth and the system is complicated, but the wine is cheap and the food is delicious, so it feels like fun.

reviews.author: Matboard Chart
reviews.text:
✏️ One line review - Hip atmosphere, good prices, there are bound to be a lot of people.

🏠 Space - Located in the basement of Samil Building, formerly known as 63 Building in Jongno. Spacious, clean, and hip atmosphere without being stuffy

🥣Food
The wine I chose was Behringer, and Cabernet Sauvignon is always delicious. For main course, I ate a lot of tteokbokki, fried sundae, risotto, pasta, and jajangmyeon. Most of them are delicious. These menu items have good wine pairings.

🙏 Service - Most of it is self-service. They are very friendly when it comes to seating information, instructions on how to use the place, and ordering.

reviews.author: BONG
reviews.text:
The atmosphere is good.
If you choose to drink alcohol through a dispenser... it's incredibly cumbersome. A very ironic way of telling you to sign up in front of you, recharge, and come back. We have entered an era where discomfort becomes emotional.

There seem to be a lot of unnecessary staff, and although they are famous for their oyster dishes, the oysters are often sold out, so if you go four or five times, you may want to try just once or twice. At least sometimes they come with grilled oysters.
It comes in a petrified form and seems to be topped with something like chewy cheese and baked. It usually costs around 5,000 won per piece.

The store itself is spacious and fancy, but people are busy rushing around, and the system in which you have to take your own food and put all your finished plates, bowls, and glasses in the dining area is at a very unfortunate level.

Only the wine glass is full, adding to the hassle of having to separately request whiskey shot glasses or ice.
I keep wondering why there are so many unnecessary employees.

There is a huge speaker, but the buzzing noise makes it difficult to hear properly and adds to the clutter.

I've been there several times for lunch and coffee, but it's actually a place I don't bother coming to in the evening.

Meanwhile, most of the sofa seats and comfortable seats inside are centered around large tables, so you can't even sit down unless you go in a group.

The price of wine and alcohol itself is quite expensive. It is more than twice the amount of tax exemption, and is similar to or more than the amount of regular restaurant sales.
The advantage is that you can drink and shop in the middle of the city. And the downside is that it is expensive. degree.

reviews.author: Hwang
reviews.text:
Directly managed branch located along the Cheonggyecheon Stream in Cheonggye 2-ga. It is used as an entire guest room on the 1st to 4th floors, and the interior is slightly different on each floor to provide consumers with a unique experience.
With a Cheonggyecheon view on every floor, it’s perfect for enjoying coffee indoors.
For example, on the 4th floor, there is a Mirror Zone reminiscent of a powder room in a beauty salon, a study space (Private Zone) unique to Hollys Coffee, and a Dim-Light table that mimics a high-end library. It can be said to be the standard of a modern cafe, to the point where it can be called the complete comfortable space we commonly think of.
When I visited in 2019, it was an ordinary large cafe, but after the renewal, it looked completely different and it was an opportunity to experience the changed management policy of Hollys Coffee. 🫖

reviews.author: senie
reviews.text: There are four floors, so each floor has a different atmosphere. There are many office workers chatting on the 1st and 2nd floors, and the 3rd and 4th floors have a study atmosphere. The store is also clean!! Even though it was daytime, the 3rd and 4th floors were quiet and nice. The drinks are also delicious 👍👍 I recommend coming here instead of Jongno 3-ga branch...

Whenever I eat with friends in Jongno 3-ga, I always
This is the place to visit. Samil Building, where I have been since I was young.
After passing through Cheonggyecheon-ro, you will arrive at a short walk. On the first floor of a four-story building

reviews.text:
It is surprising that such a large cafe was built in the middle of Jongno. It is a very impressive cafe with a spacious store, unique interior, and trendy bakery and coffee.
- Yeonnam-dong and Yeonhui-dong are cafes based in houses.
- Mullae-dong and Seongsu-dong are cafes built in renovated factories.
- In Ikseon-dong, cafes remodeled from traditional Korean houses are popular.
Corcovado has old commercial and office buildings like Euljiro.
The interior design was done using Eulji-ro as a small office.
While it is uniquely decorated, Corcovado is a large-scale building both indoors and outdoors.
Furniture made with rattan while making the most of the existing space.
It is famous for being decorated and giving off a South American or Southeast Asian feel.
I think it has a competitive edge compared to cafes.
Those who are tired of the shabby cafes in Ikseon-dong or Eulji-ro,
For those who think there are no good cafes in the city on weekends,
I think this is a cafe worth visiting at least once.

reviews.author: Cafe Tour
reviews.text:
I thought it was a new cafe, but it’s been 2 years.
From latte art with perfect vertical and horizontal symmetry on a Love La Mix glass to a Linea PB machine with an e80+Scordy2+ek43 grinder.
It's a great set of equipment.

Even the Colombian natural geisha is single.
Cafe Latte is assumed to be made with daily milk, but the synergy between the sweetness of espresso and the sweetness of milk is amazing.
You can choose your coffee beans without additional charge, and the acidic blend is a combination of Ethiopia and Colombia.
It seems like they intentionally killed the jasmine flower scent and focused on the fruity flavor.
There is no bitter, burnt, or smoky taste, and the appropriate layer of milk foam is pleasant to the touch.

Serve ice water in a glass like a Toyosasaki Stackable.
A cafe where you can enjoy luxury for 4,300 won
The coffee quality is very high.

I can't believe I finally found out about this place.
There are too many hermits.
I definitely recommend this place for coffee in Chungmuro or Euljiro!

While walking in Chungmu, it was so hot that I ran out of coffee.
I visited the article
First of all, I liked the atmosphere because it had the warm feel of wood tones, which I really like.
The interior items are also placed very emotionally!!
And best of all, it was nice that dogs were allowed.

I ordered a cream latte, and the less acidic coffee and the nutty nut cream go really well together.
I don't like sour tastes, but maybe that's why I enjoyed it even more haha.
Next time, another menu~~~~😎
